text: /cac:Exhibition Temporary Import Period inp:Transport C 1 Notes: 1) Specify Transport details. a) For all Declaration Types, specify inward transport, except for the following: i) goods released from licensed premises such as Licensed Warehouse, Excise Factory, Zero-GST Warehouse, Bonded Warehouse ii) declaration type = BKT (Blanket) iii) declaration type = SHO iv) for goods previously exempted/suspended from duties/taxes v) supplementary declaration for schemes under AISS, IGDS such as place of receipt = AISSLOC, SPIGDS b) For Declaration Type = SFZ (when there is intergateway movement): i) Specify Inward transport. ii) Specify Outward transport (if goods are not meant for storage). c) For declaration type = REX, specify: i) Inward transport. ii) Outward transport. 2) Outward Transport details need not be filled if goods are meant for storage with valid place of storage as FTZ.
